review_evidence: ProofStepPlan.sml defines datatypes 'a step and 'a plan for structured proof-step navigation, with functions fromTactic, stepAtPath, canonicalPlan — all operating on TacticParse.tac_expr, no HOL kernel interaction

TacticParse.sml implements parseTacticBlock: exp -> (int*int) tac_expr by pattern-matching on HOLSourceAST.exp (infix >>, ORELSE, by, REPEAT, EVERY, MAP_EVERY, etc.), plus mapTacExpr, linearize/unlinearize for fragment slicing, and printTacAsSML — all syntactic manipulation of tactic source text

rules.content_invariant: No file in tools/parsing/ contains any HOL kernel interaction (no Theory, Theorem, Definition, Datatype, Inductive, store_thm, new_theory, prove, or Thm.term). The tac_expr datatype is a syntactic model of tactic combinators only; parseTacticBlock consumes HOLSourceAST.exp (already-parsed SML/HOL source) and produces a tactic AST. ProofStepPlan consumes that AST for step-level navigation. All content is meta-level tooling.
